content.text: Code review complete. Let me add a brief README documenting the design decisions, then run the final fresh build + full validation:

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/submission/README.md <<'EOF'
# Offline QUIC receive/canonical-wire pipeline

`offline.Main` reads the normalized metadata lines (see CODEC.md) and runs one fresh
`offline.ReceiveAudit` per trace. `ReceiveAudit` implements the full PROTOCOL.md v3.0
contract self-contained (the retained TLS-Attacker codec sources compile untouched):

- Long/short envelope framing with BAD_HEADER detection, coalescing for I/H, terminal A.
- PN reconstruction (closest congruent to largest+1, ties to the larger value, uncapped).
- Priority: CLOSED, DROP_CID, NO_KEY, PN_RANGE, AUTH, DUPLICATE, key-epoch checks, frames.
- I/H authenticate only with annotation value 0; A annotations are key generations with
  window {current-1, current, current+1} and key-phase parity (per PROTOCOL.md wording,
  cf. "offset0"/"prefix0"/"annotation0" value style).
- Key-epoch ordering (higher epochs hold strictly larger PNs), epoch state per accepted
  packet incl. A seeds; epoch changes share the packet transaction.
- Full frame table with level/sender checks, shortest-type rule, ACK arithmetic, stream
  reference/limit/state checks, final-size, flow control, equal-overlap rules, both CID
  registries (retirements in-frame precede capacity checks; retired never reactivate).
- Write-ahead journal: any frame/semantic error rolls back every effect of its packet;
  CONNECTION_CLOSE commits its prefix plus itself and accepts the PN (PEER_CLOSE).
- Canonical envelopes: minimal varints, preserved flags/order/opaqueness, minimal PN
  width that round-trips against the pre-packet expected value, recomputed long lengths;
  exact SHA-256 reporting for packets, datagram concatenations, stream/crypto prefixes
  and ACK interval ledgers.

Ambiguous points resolved by closest reading of PROTOCOL.md:
- `closed.code` is the close cause: PEER_CLOSE, KEY_UPDATE_ERROR or the frame/semantic
  error name (the only single-type reading of "code").
- MAX_STREAMS raises `send_max_streams` monotonically like the other MAX_* frames.
- Row `epoch` is null until authentication passes (CLOSED/DROP_CID/NO_KEY/PN_RANGE/AUTH).
EOF
cd /workspace && rm -rf /workspace/tmp/classes && python3 build.py /workspace/submission/src /workspace/tmp/classes > /workspace/dev/build.log 2>&1; echo "build=$?"; cat /workspace/dev/build.log
